title: Northgate Marketplace Promotion Recovery from Return-Refund Reimbursements
content:
**Promotion terms — Northgate Marketplace Orders and the Northgate Marketplace Guarantee.** The promotional recovery taken from the return-refund reimbursement follows Northgate's marketplace promotion, under which an order whose merchandise total reaches USD 1000.00 earns a Northgate Promotional Gift Card whose initial load names that order, and the value already spent from that card, that is its redemptions less any refunds credited back to it, is recovered from the refunds of that order's merchandise, whether by a seller refund or by a guarantee reimbursement, in proportion to the merchandise refunded over the order's merchandise total, except that a refund leaving the merchandise kept on the order below USD 1000.00 recovers the whole remaining spent value, that is the value spent less what the order's earlier refunds recovered under this sentence, and a refund made when the merchandise kept on the order was already below USD 1000.00 recovers nothing, so that no more than the value spent is ever recovered on the order, value not yet spent being voided on the card only under the gift card rules; the return-refund reimbursement counts as the refund of the claimed units, made after every other refund of the order's merchandise; the merchandise refunded on the order is, line by line, the line's set price per unit times the greater of the units its unit refunds and cancellation refunds refund and the units of its claims whose claim record shows them granted; the merchandise kept before the refund is the order's merchandise total less the merchandise refunded on the order other than on the claimed units, and the merchandise kept after the refund is that amount less the price paid for the claimed units; where the order earned such a card, value has been spent from it, the merchandise kept on the order, that is its merchandise total less the merchandise refunded on it, is already below USD 1000.00 and some of the claimed units have already been refunded, this policy fixes the return-refund reimbursement only if no seller refund and no guarantee reimbursement recorded on the order is dated after the most recent return refund on the line of the claimed units, and otherwise it fixes nothing, its figure is zero and the base rule stands: "A granted claim reimburses the price paid for the affected items plus their shipping, less everything the seller already refunded on them, capped at the program's guarantee maximum per order across all claims on the order, rounded half up to the cent and paid to the original payment.": where the order earned such a card, value has been spent from it, the merchandise kept before the refund is at or above USD 1000.00 and the merchandise kept after the refund is below it, the recovery is the whole remaining spent value, which is the value spent times the merchandise kept before the refund divided by the order's merchandise total; where the order earned such a card, value has been spent from it and the merchandise kept after the refund is at or above USD 1000.00, the recovery is the value spent times the price paid for the claimed units divided by the order's merchandise total; otherwise, including where the merchandise kept before the refund is already below USD 1000.00, there is no promotional recovery.

**Records read.** The card is the Northgate Promotional Gift Card of Northgate Gift Cards and Merchandise Return Cards whose initial load names the marketplace order; the value spent is that card's redemptions less the refunds credited back to it, as its gift card entries show.

| Card earned and value spent | Merchandise kept before the refund | Merchandise kept after the refund | Recovery |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | at or above USD 1000.00 | below USD 1000.00 | the whole remaining spent value: value spent times the merchandise kept before the refund, divided by the order's merchandise total |
| yes | at or above USD 1000.00 | at or above USD 1000.00 | value spent times the price paid for the claimed units, divided by the order's merchandise total |
| yes | below USD 1000.00 | below USD 1000.00 | none |
| no card, or nothing spent | any | any | none |

**Hypothetical order (illustration only).** Merchandise total USD 1200.00, a promotional card naming the order with 60.00 spent, and no earlier merchandise refund. If the price paid for the claimed units is 100.00, the merchandise kept goes from 1200.00 to 1100.00, still at or above 1000.00, and the recovery is 60.00 times 100.00 divided by 1200.00, that is 5.00. If it is 300.00, the merchandise kept falls from 1200.00 to 900.00 and the recovery is the whole remaining 60.00. If earlier refunds of 250.00 on other lines had already left 950.00 kept, there is no recovery. A refund leaving exactly 1000.00 kept is at or above the threshold.
